description: Should my x402 API take USDC on Solana? One signed share: of the sellers with 3+ payers in a category, or the whole Bazaar, how many take Solana, with a 95% range, the share of 30-day calls their listings had, their median payers and price against the rest, and the share four weeks before. Give a category, your listing's URL, or neither for the whole Bazaar. Asked again with its ETag, an unchanged answer is a free 304. Price: $0.002 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Same price over HTTP, which any x402 client pays without MCP (prefer it if your client pays HTTP 402s): GET https://api.agoranome.com/v1/facts/solana-reach?category=web_search. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.002 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

category.description: Optional: one category (none: the whole Bazaar)
category.title: Category

if_none_match.description: Send the answer's ETag back in If-None-Match (over MCP, the if_none_match argument): while the answer is unchanged it comes back as a free 304 Not Modified.
if_none_match.title: If None Match

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
